title: Add Stepper Input
content: Create stepper input. Container: flex items-center. Minus button: w-10 h-10 border rounded-l-lg flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-gray-100, disabled when at min. Input: w-16 h-10 border-y text-center, type="number" hidden arrows. Plus button: w-10 h-10 border rounded-r-lg flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-gray-100, disabled when at max. Value display: font-medium.

variants.simple: Create number input with increment/decrement buttons.
variants.detailed: Create stepper input. Container: flex items-center. Minus button: w-10 h-10 border rounded-l-lg flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-gray-100, disabled when at min. Input: w-16 h-10 border-y text-center, type="number" hidden arrows. Plus button: w-10 h-10 border rounded-r-lg flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-gray-100, disabled when at max. Value display: font-medium.
variants.advanced: Create full-featured stepper/quantity input. Layout variants: horizontal (default), vertical (stacked buttons), compact (smaller). Buttons: minus and plus with icons, clear disabled styling (opacity, cursor-not-allowed) at min/max, hold to auto-increment (accelerating). Input: type="text" with number pattern, centered text, optional direct editing. Validation: min, max, step values, clamp on blur if outside range. Sizes: sm, md, lg with consistent proportions. Special values: min=0 for quantities, allow negative, decimal precision (step=0.1). Display formatting: optional unit suffix (e.g., "5 items"), comma thousands separator. Accessibility: aria-label for buttons ("Increase quantity", "Decrease quantity"), input has aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow. Touch: larger touch targets on mobile, haptic feedback optional. Keyboard: up/down arrows when input focused, Shift for larger step. Callbacks: onChange, onIncrement, onDecrement, onMin, onMax. Controlled and uncontrolled modes. Error state: border-red-500 when invalid. Animation: optional value change animation.
